pages.text: The $(item)firebox$() burns fuel fluids to heat whatever sits on top of it. It is the fuel-powered answer to the blaze burner.

Fireboxes placed side by side merge into one firebox, like Create fluid tanks: a square of $(item)1 x 1, 2 x 2 or 3 x 3$(), one block tall. The merged firebox shares a single fuel tank and a single exhaust tank, each holding $(item)8000 mB per block$() with Create's default tank size.

$(l)Fuels$()$(br)Only fluids in the firebox fuel list burn: $(item)LPG, butane, propane, hydrogen, diesel, naphtha and kerosene$(). The tank refuses every other fluid, so its own CO2 or a stray water line cannot clog it.

$(l)Heat$()$(br)A burning firebox counts as a lit heater:$(li)$(item)2 heat$() per block for distillation towers, chemical vats and Create steam boilers, the same as a superheated blaze burner,$(li)$(item)heated$(), not superheated, for a Create basin above it.
When it stops burning, its heat drops to nothing.
